# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and modernizes support across several platforms. Uno applications move to Uno Platform 7, Apple native assets have newer deployment baselines, and WebAssembly WebGPU linking is simplified. The release also fixes Unicode character-code validation, native data creation, buffered streams, and Android texture synchronization.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m156 includes current upstream fixes** — Updates the bundled renderer with the current m156 upstream bug-fix set. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Unicode character-code conversion corrected** — Character-code APIs now validate encoded code-unit sizes correctly and report consistent argument exceptions for invalid input. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Native data and buffered streams handled safely** — Creating SKData from C strings avoids reading past the native buffer, and front-buffered streams no longer retain their input unnecessarily. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering synchronized** — Android texture rendering now follows the display refresh cycle for more reliable presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel and text-shaping allocations reduced** — Image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 conversion, and feature-string decoding avoid unnecessary managed or native allocations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Uno WinUI views updated for Uno Platform 7** — The Uno views package and samples adopt Uno Platform 7's unified renderer and .NET 10 baseline while retaining a CPU fallback where a swap chain is unavailable. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Native assets align with current platform toolchains** — Windows dependencies, GN, Visual Studio, ANGLE, and Apple native deployment baselines are updated for current supported build environments. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420))
- **WebAssembly WebGPU linking simplified** — The WebGPU C++ support is bundled into the native archive, so consumer WebAssembly links no longer compile it alongside application code. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Bundled HarfBuzz functions load locally on Linux** — Linux native packages bind their bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, preventing symbol conflicts with an application's installed HarfBuzz library. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5366](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5366))
